minor_decisions.decision: current()/proposal() show the last persisted snapshot of the run, not the live in-memory state.
minor_decisions.rationale: The plan requires run.json after every state change. With this the board never shows a state the file does not hold. A test exposed the race when the view was read directly.

minor_decisions.decision: One user action at a time per manager; a concurrent second action gets conflict (Cancel exempt).
minor_decisions.rationale: A double-clicked answer or Accept could interleave across awaits: a second answer used to go the 'orphaned' path and send a second turn. Cheap insurance even though the extension routes messages in order.

minor_decisions.decision: Premises count as 'unchanged' when the set equals the declared premises (order ignored).
minor_decisions.rationale: Re-declaring only to reorder would add a pointless undoable history entry.

minor_decisions.decision: A backend factory that rejected is tried again at the next start; once it succeeds it is never called again.
minor_decisions.rationale: The user may install or update the Claude extension after a refused start. 'Called once' holds for successful creation.

minor_decisions.decision: A run that fails before Claude is contacted (base check, session refusal) records no attempt in attempts.jsonl.
minor_decisions.rationale: No round with Claude took place; an attempt record there would be noise in the per-goal history.

minor_decisions.decision: On recover(), a run found in 'starting' becomes failed even when it has a session id.
minor_decisions.rationale: The first turn (context bundle) may never have been sent, so the resume turn ('while you were working') would be wrong.

minor_decisions.decision: Accept after drift re-freezes only for a proved proposal; other verdicts are re-gated as gate-other without a freeze. The re-gate status is 'proved' only for a proved verdict.
minor_decisions.rationale: The readiness rules apply to the freeze, so freezing an honest 'could not formalise' proposal would always refuse Accept. gate-other needs no freeze.

minor_decisions.decision: After the gate passed, a cap reached later only interrupts the session; it adds no cap notice and never changes the verdict.
minor_decisions.rationale: The round already ended properly; the interrupt just saves quota on edits that will be discarded anyway.

minor_decisions.decision: The 30 s environment-retry wait counts as agent-active time (state gate).
minor_decisions.rationale: Simplest consistent rule (the clock runs in working and gate). It is at most 30 s of a 20-minute cap, once per finish.

minor_decisions.decision: Answers that could not reach a live tool call are kept in run.json (undeliveredAnswers) until a resumed session has received them; Resume re-sends them instead of the generic resume turn.
minor_decisions.rationale: An answer must never be lost when the resumed CLI fails to start.

minor_decisions.decision: The tool host derives the ghost's display name (lean_name if valid, free and not a keyword, else a slug of the sentence with ghost_ and _2 suffix rules). After adoption the GhostView takes core planGhostAdoption's final name (short form).
minor_decisions.rationale: GhostView.leanName must be shown before adoption, while core decides the final name.

minor_decisions.decision: Context bundle: a formalised selected ASSUMPTION without its .holds axiom is described as 'assumed, but its axiom <S>.<name>.holds is missing (add it)'.
minor_decisions.rationale: The 5.2 template has no wording for this case, and the system prompt tells Claude to add the axiom.

minor_decisions.decision: 'Stop' (discard) of an interrupted run appends an attempt with verdict 'cancelled' and then the resolution 'discarded'. Cancel during review resolves the already-recorded attempt as 'discarded'.
minor_decisions.rationale: Every ended round gets exactly one AttemptRecord, with a resolution when the user ends it.

minor_decisions.decision: Terminal transitions wait at most 10 s for the CLI session to close (it is killed in the background after that).
minor_decisions.rationale: Accept, Discard and Cancel should not hang on a misbehaving CLI.

minor_decisions.decision: The CLI's 'max_turns' result counts as the turn cap. Rate-limit statuses other than 'allowed' post one warning notice per status change.
minor_decisions.rationale: Belt and braces with the host cap; the board should show when usage is near a limit.

minor_decisions.decision: The walkthrough JSON fixtures carry test metadata (answer, premises, adopt, expect) beside the playable turns, and turns are matched by text (match) rather than by per-session index.
minor_decisions.rationale: Keeps a script in step across nudges and --resume sessions, and lets the E2E test and the dry-run script share the same files.

minor_decisions.decision: The system prompt module (src/run/systemPrompt.ts) and its fixture copy were generated from the plan's section 5.1 text by a script, one string per line.
minor_decisions.rationale: Guarantees byte-exactness (special characters, backticks). A test also compares against the live plan section.

If shadow creation fails after the premises declaration (e.g. a symlink in .lake/build), the declaration stays (an ordinary undoable M1 action) and the start is refused not-yet. The plan's ordering (base must contain the declaration) makes this unavoidable without undoing the user's history.

integration_notes:
Wiring for WP5: createRunManager({ root, runsDir: <globalStorage>/runs, workspace, services: { backend: () => run.createClaudeBackend({ claudePath, guardScriptPath: <ext>/dist/bin/telelean-path-guard.mjs, hookRuntime: llm.defaultHookRuntime(), clientApp, extensionDirs, pdeathsig: true }).then(r => r.backend), engine: gate.createLeanCheckEngine(), proposals: proposal.createProposalService(), sidecars: proposal.createRunSidecarStore(), log }, settings }); call recover() once; post `run`/`proposal` from manager.current()/proposal() on onDidChange and on ready; dispose() on window close (it persists synchronously and force-closes the CLI).
Semantics to rely on:
- start() resolves once the run is working, or after a refusal. Preflight refusals give not-yet, busy gives conflict, and nothing is created or declared.
- A failed base check or session refusal returns not-yet AND leaves a failed run whose RunView.error says why.
- A second concurrent user action gets conflict; cancel is always allowed.
- The CLI session stays open during review, so Feedback continues it. It is closed on accept/discard/cancel/failure, and resumed with --resume when needed.
- RunServices.cancelLean defaults to lean.cancelRun.
